The type MIC relays are digital microprocessor based, non directional over 
 current relays that protect against phase to phase and phase to ground faults 
 it performs the following functions:

Inverse over current, including four characteristic curves, and four values 
 for definite time protection, as well as instantaneous over current protection 
 with programmable delay; all in the same relay
Phase and ground current recorder and the operating time of the last trip

 electrical maintenance & protection manager, and approved by eng. Ahmed Moussa: 
 executive operation and maintenance manager, and certified by quality control 
 head sector eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab

Introduction
The type MIC relays are digital microprocessor based, non directional over 
 current relays that protect against phase to phase and phase to ground faults 
 it performs the following functions:
Inverse over current, including four characteristic curves, and four values 
 for definite time protection, as well as instantaneous over current protection 
 with programmable delay; all in the same relay
Phase and ground current measurement
Phase and ground current recorder and the operating time of the last trip
The first draft is initiated & tested by eng. Saber Mohamed & eng. Ragab Abd 
 Elgwad, revised by eng. Abd Elazez Shalaby, accepted by eng. Mahmoud Badawy: 
 electrical maintenance & protection manager, and approved by eng. Ahmed Moussa: 
 executive operation and maintenance manager, and certified by quality control 
 head sector eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety 
 shoes, anti static hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required
The generator must be isolated and work permit required.
Switch off DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing any card from the 
 relay module.
Tools and Equipment
Test set MANTA
Multi - meter
Test leads
Test set MANTA
Multi - meter
Test leads

 relay coil terminals B8,B9
Connect the relay points A8&A3 TO manta stop 
 points
Start increasing current from zero until pick up
To Get Time
Use the same connection
Adjust the current by short manta current 
 terminals at 1.5 I
Start inject current and record the time
